test_parameter_count: test the parameter_count function to count parameters of a PyTorch model and its submodules
test_parameter_count_table: test the parameter_count_table function to format a model's parameter count as a readable table
test_NetWithReuse: test the NetWithReuse module that shares weights between conv layers to verify correct parameter counting
test_NetWithDupPrefix: test the NetWithDupPrefix module with similarly named layers to verify table output handles prefix collisions
run_parameter_count_tests: run the unittest suite to verify parameter_count and parameter_count_table work correctly with reused and duplicate prefix modules
